<style>
        .section-34 {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 1334px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: #fffaf6;
            color: #2b1720;
            font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
        }

        .section-34__container {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            display: grid;
            width: 100%;
            align-items: start;
            gap: 32px;
            padding: 24px 16px 40px;
        }

        .section-34__media {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            width: 100%;
            aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
            margin: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: 24px;
            background: #2b1720;
        }

        .section-34__iframe {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            border: 0;
        }

        .section-34__content {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            display: flex;
            width: 100%;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: start;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .section-34__title {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            margin: 0;
            overflow-wrap: anywhere;
            color: #24121a;
            font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 5vw, 3rem);
            font-weight: 400;
            line-height: 1.15;
        }

        .section-34__text {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            margin: 0;
            overflow-wrap: anywhere;
            color: #624c55;
            font-size: clamp(0.9375rem, 2.4vw, 1.0625rem);
            line-height: 1.75;
        }

        .section-34__list {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            display: grid;
            width: 100%;
            align-items: start;
            gap: 8px;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            list-style: none;
        }

        .section-34__item {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0, 1fr);
            align-items: start;
            gap: 8px;
            overflow-wrap: anywhere;
            color: #463139;
            font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 2.2vw, 1rem);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .section-34__item::before {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            display: grid;
            width: 24px;
            height: 24px;
            place-items: center;
            border: 1px solid #f0708b;
            border-radius: 50%;
            color: #df3157;
            content: "\2713";
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        @media (min-width: 576px) {
            .section-34__container {
              
            }

            .section-34__content {
                gap: 24px;
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 768px) {
            .section-34__container {
                grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 56fr) minmax(0, 44fr);
                align-items: center;
                gap: 40px;
             
            }

            .section-34--video-left .section-34__media {
                grid-column: 1;
            }

            .section-34--video-left .section-34__content {
                grid-column: 2;
            }

            .section-34--video-right .section-34__media {
                grid-column: 2;
                grid-row: 1;
            }

            .section-34--video-right .section-34__content {
                grid-column: 1;
                grid-row: 1;
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 992px) {
            .section-34__container {
                gap: 56px;
                
            }

            .section-34__content {
                padding: 24px 0;
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 1200px) {
            .section-34__container {
                gap: 64px;
                
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 1400px) {
            .section-34__container {
                gap: 80px;
                
            }
        }
    </style>
